segments.text: The nurse in charge of ‘punishment-style service’. She is the head nurse with the most seniority at the "Sasaoyama Clinic".
An eccentric who marches to her own beat, yet skilled in both nursing and sex. A married woman and mother of one child. Her maiden name was Yokoyama.
Rich in life experience, she always carries herself with composure and an air of accepting anything.
She's always cheerful and smiling broadly, yet possesses a strong intuition that sees through all.
She's always been the type others rely on, and she herself tends to want to take charge.
At the same time, she also has a desire to be led by a dependable man.
She became a nurse because it seemed like a stable career choice. She isn't particularly passionate about her work, but she takes everything seriously once she commits to it.
Her husband works in computers, as a systems engineer. He's constantly busy, often gone for days at a time, and their sex life is rather bland.
However, he's financially successful, so they have no money troubles. Influenced by her husband, she became knowledgeable about computers, even setting up a home server to run a website.
After marriage, she quit nursing to become a full-time housewife. Then, she discovered online that a hospital was hiring. Bored with her peaceful daily life, she promptly decided to return to work.
Her husband initially objected, but being lenient with her, he reluctantly agreed. Though he remains unaware that nursing and treatment equate to sex.
Regarding her current job, she feels no guilt towards her husband, she strictly separates it as just work.
At first, she approaches the protagonist with the composure of a veteran, speaking to him condescendingly but motherly. However, the closer they become, the more she treats him as a man.
Due to the love she still feels for her husband, she hesitates to become seriously involved with the protagonist.
She watches over the other nurses like daughters or younger sisters. Mayuri is like a reckless youngest daughter, while Suzuka is like a low-maintenance eldest daughter.
She basically dotes on both, but sometimes gives them a stern talking-to. She has a long-standing relationship with the hospital director, built on mutual trust.
During ‘service’, she transforms completely from her everyday self, serving obediently. She frequently performs breast play and fellatio, prioritizing the protagonist's pleasure above all.
However, as things escalate, she gradually begins to crave pleasure. Going behind her husband's back, she privately meets with the protagonist outside the hospial, her guilt washed away by pleasure.

「笹尾山医院」で婦長を務めるベテランナース。既婚者で一時の母。29歳。
いつも笑顔を絶やさない、大らかで落ち着いた雰囲気の大人の女性。
常にマイペースを崩さないが、仕事ぶりは優秀で、ご奉仕も完璧。
普段は主人公に対しても大人の余裕を持って接してくるが、「奉仕」においては、そうした日常とは打って変わって、フェラチオやパイズリなど、相手の快感を最優先してくれる従順さを見せる。
しかし、次第に自身の快感にも貪欲になり、自らも快楽に溺れていく……。
『責められ系奉仕』担当の看護婦。
舞台となる『笹尾山医院』最古参のベテラン看護婦。婦長。
マイペースな変わり者、しかしＨの腕も看護も達者。
人妻であり、一児の母。(旧姓は横山)
The nurse in charge of ‘healing services’. She has only recently started working at the ‘Sasaoyama Clinic’, the setting of the story, and the protagonist becomes her first ‘assigned patient’.
She has a gentle disposition and is kind to everyone. She is somewhat naive and easily deceived. In particular, her knowledge of sexual matters is lacking.
As a nurse, she performs her duties reliably, though her slow pace is a drawback. This led her to quit her previous hospital job because she couldn't keep up with the work speed.
Still unable to abandon her desire to work as a nurse, she was invited by her nursing school senior, Ryouka, to work at this hospital.
She is a virgin and, having attended an all-girls school, has never dated a man. Because of this, she initially acts somewhat timid around the protagonist.
She works meticulously but struggles with casual conversation. She can interact normally with him as a “patient,” but becomes flustered when she consciously thinks of him as a “man.”
However, as her affection grows, she gradually opens up. If you become closer, she will offer her virginity.
Her specialty is cooking, covering Japanese, Western, and Chinese cuisine. She likes bringing well prepared homemade bento lunches.
Her ‘service’ style leans toward affectionate, soothing, or lover-like atmospheres. She always shows shyness and hesitation during intimate moments.
Though inexperienced, she strives earnestly and devotedly to please. As the protagonist explores her, she gradually discovers feminine pleasures.

A nurse specializing in ‘punitive care’. She was Mayuri's senior at nursing school and the one who recruited her. She became a nurse to gain a skill. She never fails to send money home to her family.
She lives her life with the clear goal of providing a good life for her younger brother and sister. Because of this, she dislikes people who drift through life aimlessly.
She's lively, talkative, energetic, and a hard worker who handles her duties thoroughly. She's deeply compassionate and easily moved to tears.
She loves stuffed animals and trinkets, but her financial constraints from sending money home make it hard to indulge, which troubles her.
Being a young woman, she's particular about fashion. She adorns her nurse's cap with accessories or modifies her uniform, focusing on small and inexpensive ways to look stylish.
Towards the protagonist, she's kind from the start but maintains a clear patient-nurse stance.
However, as intimacy grows with rising affection, she begins to show hints of clinginess.
Her father left the family for another woman, leaving her somewhat distrustful of men. She's dated several times, but each boyfriend ended up running away.
Since no man could live up to her expectations of reliability and masculinity, she recently resolved herself to live without relying on men.
During ‘service’, she has a sharp tongue and frequently uses reverse sexual harassment-style verbal abuse.
Her strong vitality fuels intense sexual desire, but she treats ‘service’ strictly as work, consciously avoiding becoming emotionally invested. Hence, her preference for handjobs and footjobs.
However, later on, she begins to actively enjoy it herself. When it comes to private affairs, she can be either the receiver or the giver. Special things can happen if you manage to open her heart.
